name: Paladin · Knight style E (holy crusader)
description: Dame Seraphine as a bare-headed holy crusader in the plumed Knight’s style, turned the same way as the Knight (facing right in 3/4, a leaning sturdy stance, about his height). Her bare head is turned right in 3/4 like the Knight’s: short chestnut hair filling the top and back of the head, tied at the nape in a short tail that sways, a thin gold circlet with a small crimson gem across her brow, and a small few-pixel face at the head’s front, a little toward the viewer so both blue eyes show under dark lashes (the nose’s light between them, a pixel of cheek past the far eye), the nose’s tip, mouth and chin pointing the way she walks. Her head sits on a neck between two big rounded steel pauldrons rimmed in gold, her chest and tabard turned in 3/4 to the right. Heavy steel plate (gorget, pauldrons, vambraces, gauntlets, cuisses, greaves with knee glints) under a deep crimson tabard with a gold cross, a leather belt with a gold buckle and a gold-hemmed skirt that swings, and a short crimson cape that ripples and streams behind her. On her far arm, held forward at her right side and seen a little angled, a tall kite shield of dark polished steel with a gold rim and a gold cross; in her near hand a straight knightly sword with a gold crossguard, held low with its point trailing back. Her smite raises the sword high behind her head, blazing with holy light, brings it over and down in a gold smear, and on frame 19 lands in a broad gold-to-white crescent while a pillar of holy light falls on the foe ahead with a white flash, rays and a shock along the ground; the pillar then breaks into white-hot sparks and she recovers. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material), hue-shifted ramps (purple-grey steel shadows, warm pink lights); only the holy light (the blade’s blaze, the smear’s edge, the crescent, the pillar, the flash and the sparks) glows at night.
